title: List tab groups
when: Use the returned groupId, windowId and tabIds before changing a group.

title: Create a tab group
when: Use your page; replace research with your task label and keep the returned groupId.

title: Retitle or recolour a tab group
when: Set groupId from the group list; omitted fields stay unchanged.
code: return await neo.cdp('Browser.updateTabGroup', { groupId, title: 'research notes', color: 'blue', collapsed: false });

title: Add tabs to a group
when: Set groupId from the group list and tabIds from your page.tabId values.

title: Remove tabs from a group
when: Set tabIds from your pages; they stay open, and an empty group disappears.

title: Close a tab group
when: Set groupId from the group list and inspect its tabIds: this closes every tab in the group. Never include Neo's reserved blank tab or use group closure to bypass a protected close refusal.

title: List windows
when: Use the returned windowId; liveBrowserContextId identifies a loaded profile.

title: Open a window
when: No input is required; to choose a loaded profile, pass its browserContextId from the profile list.

title: Close a window
when: Set windowId from the window list and inspect its tabs. Closing Neo's reserved blank tab or its window is refused as script / unsupported; leave it open and close only your own pages or use a separate window.

title: Open a tab in a chosen window
when: Set windowId from the window list and url to the destination; find the returned tabId in context.pages() in the next run.
code: const { tab } = await neo.cdp('Browser.createTab', { windowId, url, background: true }); return { tabId: tab.tabId };

title: List profiles
when: Use browserProfileId for a saved profile and browserContextId for a loaded profile; the latter expires on restart.

title: Load a profile
when: Set browserProfileId from the profile list; use the returned profile.browserContextId when creating a window.

title: Read recent history
when: No input is required; to choose a loaded profile, pass its browserContextId from the profile list.

title: Bring a tab to the front
when: Use the page you intend to select in its window.
